decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's office portfolio with clear fit to flexible workplace demand, the desk system still offers strategic upside that likely exceeds its carrying cost.
The chair family is adjacent to the core range and complements integrated interior solutions, so management would likely retain it unless sales have clearly disappointed.
Floor cushions are a more peripheral niche item for a broad premium furniture maker, and after several years the option value is likely lower than the benefit of refocusing resources.
A designer-led upholstered sofa fits the firm's established living and lounge business well, so absent strong negative evidence it is more likely to be continued.
The high standing table matches the firm's move toward adaptable contemporary work settings and is a relatively natural complement to its existing offer.

Although rugs are more distant from the historical core, this collection was presented as a flagship direction and supports the firm's broader interior concept, which argues for keeping it on the market.
